## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant design gate or issue when applicable.

## Validation

List commands run and results. Distinguish planning checks, numerical comparisons, RTL simulation and hardware measurements. Explain unrun checks that matter to this change.

## Evidence and compatibility

Describe affected arithmetic/profile, ABI/layout, resource/traffic assumptions or source identities. Record new versions and primary sources when applicable.

- [ ] Relevant repository checks pass, or failures are explained.
- [ ] Claims match the evidence and pending gates remain explicit.
- [ ] Any claim that the CPU is good, performant or fast cites a review record under `cpu/review-rubric.md`.
- [ ] Imported material retains its license/provenance; generated files and weights are excluded.
